answer: Require every agent identity to complete a verifiable delay function before its epoch work counts: a VDF chain that takes twenty minutes of strictly sequential computation, like an ember that cannot be hurried by adding more hands. One honest agent pays a single slow burn per epoch; a Sybil farmer fielding a thousand fake identities faces a thousand sequential burns stretching to the horizon, since parallelism buys nothing against a VDF. Each output carries a saffron seal anyone can verify in milliseconds, so forged proofs are rejected instantly while genuine work keeps its place in line.
